meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有转录组数据,想找到基因间的调控网络
copy.tagline_en: Identify regulatory relationships between transcription factors and target genes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have transcriptomics data and want to uncover gene regulatory networks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能读取基因表达矩阵，用 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3 推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系，产出含 TF、target、importance 的网络表并导出 TSV。
howto.when: 当你要从转录组数据（如 bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq 等）推断基因调控网络、找出转录因子与靶基因关系时触发。

say.text: 用 GRNBoost2 从这个表达矩阵推断调控网络，导出 TSV
用 GENIE3 跑同一份数据，和 GRNBoost2 结果对比
say.note: 两种算法各出一份网络，可互相参照

say.text: 加载人类 TF 列表，限制 TF 后推断网络，seed 用 123
say.note: 只输出给定转录因子与靶基因的调控关系

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can read gene expression matrices, infer regulatory links between transcription factors and target genes with GRNBoost2 or GENIE3, and output a table of TF, target, and importance scores saved as TSV.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you analyze transcriptomics data such as bulk RNA-seq or single-cell RNA-seq to infer gene regulatory networks or find transcription factor-target gene relationships.

say_en.text: Use GRNBoost2 on this expression matrix to infer a network and export TSV.
say_en.note: You get a table with TF, target, and importance columns.

say_en.text: Run GENIE3 on the same data and compare it with the GRNBoost2 result.
say_en.note: Both algorithms produce a network you can compare.

say_en.text: Load a human TF list, restrict inference to those TFs, and set seed 123.
say_en.note: Output only links for the given transcription factors.
